# Minimal Correct Slice

Under uncertainty, deliver the smallest end-to-end slice that demonstrates correctness.

## Vertical slice first

Prefer one path working end-to-end over many stubs.

## Expand by necessity

Add complexity only when a requirement or verifier demands it.

## Honest partials

If blocked, document the blocker and what was proven instead of silent omission.
